title: Remove _seed_mock_data tool and rewrite TS test-mode tests
description: Once Swift tests cover test-mode guards: remove _seed_mock_data case from MCPServer.swift callTool switch, remove seedData method from MockStore.swift, remove store property from MCPServer (only needed for seed), rewrite test/test-mode.test.ts to test what it can without seeding (create in non-test list blocked, create-list without prefix blocked, operations in test-prefixed lists succeed). The deeper guard tests are now in Swift.
close_reason: Removed _seed_mock_data case from MCPServer, seedData method from MockStore, unused 'store' property from MCPServer. Rewrote test/test-mode.test.ts to cover: blocks non-test list create, blocks create in default list, allows test-prefixed list, full CRUD lifecycle (list/create/update/delete) inside a test-prefixed list. Deeper guard coverage now lives in Tests/AppleRemindersCoreTests/TestModeGuardTests.swift. All 89 TS tests + 37 Swift tests passing.

title: Write test-mode guard tests for create/update/delete
description: Test all 5 test-mode guard paths in RemindersManager: createList blocks non-test lists, createReminders blocks non-test lists, updateReminders blocks reminders in non-test lists, updateReminders blocks moving to non-test lists, deleteReminders blocks reminders in non-test lists. Use MockStore with directly populated calendars/reminders — no _seed_mock_data needed. Toggle test mode via setenv/unsetenv.
close_reason: All 5 test-mode guard paths covered (createList, createReminders, updateReminders source, updateReminders move-target, deleteReminders) + 2 allow-path tests + 1 disabled sanity test. 8/8 passing.

title: Add XCTest target to Package.swift and create test directory
description: Add a .testTarget for AppleRemindersCoreTests in Package.swift depending on AppleRemindersCore. Create Tests/AppleRemindersCoreTests/ directory with a minimal passing test to verify the setup works with swift test.
close_reason: XCTest target added to Package.swift; Tests/AppleRemindersCoreTests created with smoke test + env helpers; swift test passes (2/2)

title: Add Swift unit tests for RemindersManager business logic
description: Epic: Add XCTest-based Swift unit tests that test RemindersManager directly with MockStore, eliminating the need for the _seed_mock_data MCP tool hack. Tests should cover test-mode guards, CRUD operations, input validation, and list resolution. Once Swift tests cover these, remove _seed_mock_data from MCPServer.swift and MockStore.swift.
close_reason: Epic complete: XCTest target + 37 Swift unit tests covering test-mode guards, CRUD lifecycle, and input validation; _seed_mock_data tool/method removed; TS test-mode tests rewritten. All sub-beads closed.

title: Fix EKReminder.isAllDay compile error on macOS
description: EKReminder doesn't have isAllDay (that's EKEvent-only). Fixed by inferring from dueDateComponents (hour==nil means all-day) and modifying components in the setter.

title: Implement field filtering and null stripping in encodableArray
description: Refactor encodableArray to support field subsetting and null stripping as final step. Full always includes all keys.

title: Add outputDetail parameter to query_reminders (minimal/compact/full)
description: New param controlling how much detail is returned. compact is default. JMESPath overrides to full.

title: Add recurrence/RRULE support
description: Add recurrence rule support to reminders. The Claude iOS API supports full iCalendar RRULE with structured helper fields: frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly), interval, daysOfWeek, dayOfMonth, months, position, and end conditions (count or until date). Also includes humanReadableFrequency. Needs to be added to create_reminders, update_reminders, and the reminder output model. EventKit supports this via EKRecurrenceRule.

title: Add alarm support (absolute + relative)
description: Add alarm/notification support to reminders. The Claude iOS API supports an array of alarms per reminder, with two types: absolute (specific datetime) and relative (seconds before due date). This needs to be added to create_reminders, update_reminders, and the reminder output model. EventKit supports this via EKAlarm with absoluteDate and relativeOffset.

title: Claude iOS Reminders API Parity
description: Epic: Implement all missing features to reach parity with the Claude iOS Reminders API (reminder_*_v0 tools). See docs/plans/2026-02-11_compare-reminders-api.md for the full comparison.

title: Write input validation tests
description: Test edge cases in RemindersManager: empty/whitespace title rejected, invalid priority string rejected, invalid date format rejected, nonexistent list name gives helpful error, nonexistent reminder ID gives error, abbreviated ID resolution works correctly.
close_reason: 15 input validation tests passing: empty/whitespace titles, invalid priority on create+update, invalid date on create+update, unknown list name (w/ available lists) / id, nonexistent reminder id on update+delete, abbreviated id resolution (unique + ambiguous), dueDateIncludesTime guard, alarm offset/date validation.

title: Write CRUD lifecycle tests
description: Test the happy path through RemindersManager: create a list, create reminders with various fields (title, notes, priority, due date, URL), query them back, update fields (including clearable fields), mark complete/incomplete, move between lists, delete. Verify output models have correct values.
close_reason: 12 CRUD lifecycle tests passing: list creation, create-with-fields, batch create w/ partial failures, query (plain + searchText), update (title/priority, clear notes+due, completion toggle, move between lists), delete (single, batch w/ partial failures).

title: Add comprehensive outputDetail test coverage
description: Added 6 new tests: isCompleted with status:all, listName with all lists, JMESPath ignores outputDetail, field rename verification, default=compact, full detail field presence.

title: Fix pre-existing api-parity test failures (null vs undefined)
description: Fixed two api-parity tests that expected .toBeNull() but should have used .toBeUndefined() since encodableArray strips nil fields.

title: Add Linux/cross-platform build support (#if canImport(EventKit))
description: Added conditional compilation guards so the project builds on Linux using mock mode. EventKit code is gated behind #if canImport(EventKit).

title: Wire JMESPath override: ignore outputDetail when query is present
description: When JMESPath query param is provided, always use full fields as input regardless of outputDetail setting.

title: Add dateFrom/dateTo parameters to query_reminders
description: Add dateFrom and dateTo parameters to query_reminders for convenient date range filtering. Like the Claude iOS API, these should have semantic switching: for incomplete reminders filter by due date, for completed reminders filter by completion date. ISO 8601 format. Medium effort.

title: Add searchText parameter to query_reminders
description: Add a searchText parameter to query_reminders as a convenient shortcut for text search across reminder titles and notes. This is simpler than requiring JMESPath contains() expressions for common text search use cases. JMESPath remains available as the power-user option.

title: Add dueDateIncludesTime field
description: Add dueDateIncludesTime boolean field to reminder creation, update, and output. Maps to EventKit's isAllDay property on EKCalendarItem. When false, the reminder is all-day. Low effort change.

title: Add url field to reminders
description: Add url field to reminder creation, update, and output. EventKit supports this natively via EKReminder.url (inherited from EKCalendarItem). Low effort change.
